# ZeroBox

> ZeroBox is a free, offline-first CTF and OSCP preparation tracker that runs in the browser. It tracks Hack The Box and TryHackMe machines on a Kanban board, ships a pentest methodology checklist, an OSCP cheatsheet with reverse shells, and a 24h OSCP/CPTS exam simulator. All data stays in the user's browser (LocalStorage and IndexedDB); there is no backend. Site: https://ctftracker.com/

ZeroBox is an independent project and is not affiliated with Hack The Box, TryHackMe or OffSec.

## App
- [CTF tracker](https://ctftracker.com/tracker/): Kanban, table and grid board for HTB and THM machines
- [Methodology checklist](https://ctftracker.com/methodology/): eight-phase attack lifecycle with copyable commands
- [Cheatsheet](https://ctftracker.com/cheatsheets/): commands and a reverse shell generator with LHOST and LPORT filled in
- [CPTS notes](https://ctftracker.com/cpts-manual/): Obsidian-style notes with wikilinks
- [Exam simulator](https://ctftracker.com/exam/): timed OSCP, CPTS and CRTO practice
- [Writeups](https://ctftracker.com/writeup/): Markdown writeup editor
- [Analytics](https://ctftracker.com/analytics/): skill radar and activity heatmap
- [Evidence vault](https://ctftracker.com/vault/): credentials, flags and hashes per target

## Static references (readable without the app)
- [Machines](https://ctftracker.com/machines/): directory of HTB and THM machines by platform, OS and difficulty, with writeups and attack paths for solved machines at /machines/<name>/
- [Reverse shells](https://ctftracker.com/revshells/): reverse, bind, MSFVenom, HoaxShell and TTY upgrade one-liners grouped by language
- [Methodology guide](https://ctftracker.com/methodology-guide/): the eight phases, each at /methodology/<phase>/
- [Cheatsheet library](https://ctftracker.com/cheatsheet-library/): topic pages at /cheatsheets/<topic>/ (recon, web, exploitation, Linux privesc, Active Directory, pivoting, file transfers)
- [CPTS notes](https://ctftracker.com/cpts-notes/): short study notes with commands

## Optional
- [Source code](https://github.com/0xdnd/ctf-tracker): React, Vite and Tailwind, non-commercial license
